biggest_catch: The referrer's $75 requires the friend to open both savings AND checking accounts; you get nothing if they only open a savings account.
catches: Referrer earns $75 for each qualified referral that joins NGFCU.
Award maximum $750 per calendar year to a single referrer.
Referred applicant must open an NGFCU savings AND checking account for the referrer to be eligible.
Referrer must be a current NGFCU member in good standing and at least 18 years old.
Referral awards are deposited into the referrer's NGFCU regular share savings account and are subject to taxation.
The friend's bonus is separate and tiered: $25 for 10 debit transactions + paperless statements within 90 days, plus $50 for two direct deposits of $100+ within 90 days.
Full program details at share.ngfcu.us/refer; NGFCU reserves the right to change or cancel the program at any time.
